text:
jordan: FYI saw a perf regression on qwen-7b fp8-kv after the kernel-router change — p50 tokens/sec down ~18% on long prefixes. attaching quick flame diff.
li: can you paste the runtime snippet? also, did you see fallback logs to FP16 or BF16?
jordan: snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-17T12:34:56Z] kernel-router: selected kernel=matmul_fast_v2
[2026-03-17T12:34:56Z] kvcache: precision=FP8 fallback=FP16 reason=quant_overflow
```
flame shows matmul_fast_v2 hot path latency increased.
emily: repro command + batch shape please — want to reproduce on my workstation.
jordan: repro:
```
./run_infer --model qwen-7b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --prefix 600 --use-kv-cache --quant fp8
```
Observe p50 ~120ms -> 145ms after the router change.
rahul: hunch: matmul_fast_v2 has a slow path for 128x128 GEMMs when head_dim misaligns (64-head vs 128-block) causing an extra transpose/fallback. fp8 dequant path combined with eviction is introducing a transient device memcpy.
li: can you confirm by forcing kernel=matmul_ref for that shape? also try eviction_policy=retain_prefix to see mem churn impact.
emily: i ran that — forcing `matmul_ref` restores p50 to baseline (so kernel matters). `eviction_policy=retain_prefix` removes FP16 fallback logs and reduces transient GC by ~10%.
jordan: saved heap profile: https://redwood-internal/ars/heap-diff-178123
heap diff shows ~12MB transient during dequant/dequant->copy step.
rahul: propose short-term mitigation: update kernel-router rule to prefer `matmul_ref` when head_dim % 64 != 0 OR seq > 512 with fp8 enabled. long-term: fix matmul_fast_v2 to avoid the extra device-host memcpy on odd head dims.
li: i'll open a tiny PR for router rule + unit test. will add a regression test with `--seq 1024 --prefix 600` and gate it in CI perf checks. @emily can you add the harness to the perf dashboard? :thumbsup:
perf-bot: perf-alert: qwen-7b fp8-kv p50 regression detected (18%). Dashboard: https://perf.redwood/qwen7b/alerts/178123 [profiles attached]
jordan: created issue + PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/827 — assigning @li @rahul to drive the patch. thanks all.
